name: watcher
description: AI-powered PR review agent using editor-provided models

watcher.autoStage.description: Automatically stage Watcher-generated files (.watcher/) after review

watcher.baseBranch.description: Base branch to compare against for PR review (e.g. origin/main, origin/develop). If empty, repo config must provide it.

watcher.showProblems.description: Show AI findings in VS Code Problems panel

watcher.aiProvider.description: AI Provider to use for reviews. 'vscode' uses the editor's Copilot/Language Models. 'ollama' uses a local Ollama instance.

watcher.ollamaUrl.description: URL of the local Ollama instance (only used if aiProvider is 'ollama')

watcher.ollamaModel.description: Model name to use with Ollama (only used if aiProvider is 'ollama'). Ensure you have pulled this model (`ollama pull <model>`).
